$comment: Machine-readable mirror of specification/v0.4/conformance.md. The Markdown document is normative; this catalog assigns a stable identifier to every MUST/MUST NOT/SHOULD obligation it states, so validators can report which requirement an issue violates. Each rule quotes its normative sentence in source_text (Markdown emphasis and code ticks removed); tests/test_conformance_catalogs.py keeps the two in sync.
claim_template: Aligned with AI Operations Specification v0.4-draft as observed on {date}.

check_kinds.schema: Decidable by validating the artifact against the schema selected by artifact_type.
check_kinds.semantic: Decidable from the artifact alone with the graph and identity checks this document lists.
check_kinds.process: A behavioral obligation on the implementation; it cannot be decided by inspecting one artifact.

rules.requirement: Emit an artifact that validates against the schema selected by artifact_type.
rules.source_text: Emit an artifact that validates against the schema selected by artifact_type.

rules.requirement: Preserve globally unique object identities within a Run artifact.
rules.source_text: Preserve globally unique object identities within a Run artifact.

rules.requirement: Preserve unique relationship and event identities.
rules.source_text: Preserve unique relationship and event identities.

rules.requirement: Ensure an end timestamp does not precede its start timestamp.
rules.source_text: Ensure an end timestamp does not precede its start timestamp.

rules.requirement: Resolve every non-external relationship endpoint to an object in the artifact with the declared type.
rules.source_text: Resolve every non-external relationship endpoint to an object in the artifact with the declared type.

rules.requirement: Contain every Step in its Run exactly once.
rules.source_text: Contain every Step in its Run exactly once.

rules.requirement: Connect every runtime occurrence to exactly one Step using observed-in.
rules.source_text: Connect every runtime occurrence to exactly one Step using observed-in.

rules.requirement: Give every Evaluation at least one evaluates target.
rules.source_text: Give every Evaluation at least one evaluates target.

rules.requirement: Support workflow_id with a matching run-of relationship.
rules.source_text: Support workflow_id with a matching run-of relationship.

rules.requirement: Ensure event targets resolve with the declared object type.
rules.source_text: Ensure event targets resolve with the declared object type.

rules.requirement: Reject self-relationships and cycles in structural, causal, and ordering graphs.
rules.source_text: Reject self-relationships and cycles in structural, causal, and ordering graphs.

rules.requirement: When representing retries, preserve distinct occurrence identities for each attempt and link each retry attempt to the prior attempt with an explicit recoverability edge such as follows or caused.
rules.source_text: When representing retries, preserve distinct occurrence identities for each attempt and link each retry attempt to the prior attempt with an explicit recoverability edge such as follows or caused.

rules.requirement: Mark every reference to an object outside the artifact with external: true.
rules.source_text: An external reference MUST set external: true.

rules.requirement: Do not report an external reference as verified unless it was resolved.
rules.source_text: External resolution is the consumer's responsibility and MUST NOT be reported as verified unless it was resolved.

rules.requirement: Perform schema and semantic validation before treating an artifact as aligned.
rules.source_text: A consumer claiming draft alignment MUST perform schema and semantic validation before treating an artifact as aligned.

rules.requirement: Preserve unknown namespaced extensions.
rules.source_text: It MUST preserve unknown namespaced extensions

rules.requirement: Do not interpret structural validity as factual accuracy.
rules.source_text: MUST NOT interpret structural validity as factual accuracy.

rules.requirement: Preserve unrecognized attributes keys and namespaced extensions entries, and do not treat their presence as a validation failure.
rules.source_text: Consumers MUST preserve unrecognized attributes keys and namespaced extensions entries rather than discarding them, and MUST NOT treat their presence as a validation failure.

rules.requirement: Reject an artifact that contains a value outside a closed vocabulary rather than guessing its meaning (decision D-004).
rules.source_text: consumers MUST reject an artifact that contains one rather than guessing its meaning.

rules.requirement: Do not invent new members of a closed vocabulary (decision D-004).
rules.source_text: producers MUST NOT invent new members of a closed enum

rules.requirement: Name namespaced extensions with a reverse-domain name outside the aiops namespace.
rules.source_text: Namespaced extensions objects, which MUST use a reverse-domain name outside the aiops namespace.

rules.requirement: Describe the implementation as aligned with the v0.4 draft, not stably conformant.
rules.source_text: implementations MUST describe themselves as aligned with the v0.4 draft, not stably conformant.

rules.requirement: Include the draft marker and observation date in an alignment claim.
rules.source_text: A claim SHOULD include the draft marker and observation date
